author: John Khan

face_set.manifest_policy: Exact SHA-256 image-content hashes frozen in advance. No training, tuning or data duplication.

metric: A consented or explicitly local shade-class path yields only fictional listed products; independent human-labelled undertone/depth agreement, interpretable reasons, privacy and no diagnosis. Unlabelled samples are UNPROVEN, never silently passed.

test_protocol.source: Frozen photos remain offline; manual baseline uses human-labelled undertone/depth, not race or inferred skin tone.
test_protocol.comparison: For skinopt-in, YouCam calls require adult consent and paid-free quota checks; cannot be exercised on all faces without sufficient legal units. Missing measurements stay UNPROVEN.
test_protocol.reference: Human-approved controlled-lighting depth and undertone labels, separately provisioned; no colour classification by race.
test_protocol.rejection: Invalid lighting, missing lab reference, or withdrawn consent means UNPROVEN for that face, never impute labels.

notes: Preregistered acceptance proposal, not measured performance; provider integration uses mocks in the automated test suite.
The full set and all required matrix slices must pass. Do not count synthetic checks as real-face observations.
